question: PC1 无法访问 PC2，请检查这个 OSPF 单区域实验。

configs.R1:
#
sysname R1
#
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 10.12.0.1 255.255.255.0
 undo shutdown
#
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/2
 ip address 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0
 undo shutdown
#
ospf 1 router-id 1.1.1.1
 area 0
  network 10.12.0.0 0.0.0.255
  network 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255
#
return
configs.R2:
#
sysname R2
#
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 10.12.0.2 255.255.255.0
 undo shutdown
#
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/2
 ip address 192.168.20.1 255.255.255.0
 undo shutdown
#
ospf 1 router-id 2.2.2.2
 area 0
  network 10.12.0.0 0.0.0.255
  network 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255
#
interface GE0/0/1
 ip address 10.23.0.2 255.255.255.0
 ospf enable 1 area 1
#
return
configs.R3:
#
sysname R3
#
interface GE0/0/1
 ip address 10.23.0.3 255.255.255.0
 undo shutdown
#
ospf 1 router-id 3.3.3.3
 area 1
  network 10.23.0.0 0.0.0.255
#
return

title: 15 · 合法的多区域拓扑
description: 按互联链路比较区域，不能要求全网所有设备的区域相同。
